name: kettlebell contralateral reverse lunge
description: A reverse lunge with the kettlebell opposite the front, working leg.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and keep the opposite leg planted in front.
Step backward with the leg on the kettlebell side.
Lower until the back knee nears the floor, keeping the front foot planted.
Push through the front foot to stand. Finish your reps, then switch hands and legs.
